features: Slide A: retained goblet cells and intracytoplasmic/luminal mucin throughout tumour glands; Slide A: villous/papillary, serrated-appearing low-grade architecture with an adenoma-like residual component; Slide B: conventional non-mucinous adenocarcinoma with crowded, elongated, hyperchromatic pseudostratified nuclei, cribriform/solid areas and desmoplastic stroma, no goblet cells; Slide B: luminal necrotic debris (dirty necrosis pattern)

These are tendencies that overlap between groups, not reliable discriminators, so the call is weak, at about 0.64. The colour difference (A is pale blue-grey, B is saturated purple) is a staining or scanning effect and was not used.

features: A: diffuse exophytic villous/papillary architecture with thin fibrovascular cores (villous-adenoma-like growth) across all 8 fields and overview; A: tall columnar pseudostratified cells with uniform elongated low-grade nuclei, little desmoplastic stroma; B: infiltrative back-to-back/cribriform glands in desmoplastic stroma with dirty luminal necrosis (conventional NOS pattern); B: more vesicular, pleomorphic nuclei (esp. field 7)
